notes: The incidence of accidental deaths in all the States taken together recorded
an increase of 5.3% in 1986 over 1985. Out of 24 States, 16 States recorded
an increase in total number of accidental deaths during 1986 over 1985.

over 1985 in the Union as a whole. The Union Territories, which
registered an increase in the total number of accidental deaths in 1986 over
1985, were D&N Haveli, Delhi, Pondicherry and Goa, Daman & Diu. Rest
